reviews.comment: Dr. Cline is amazing. She is thorough, and explains the reasoning really well behind topics. I feel very prepared for future courses because of her teaching style. You really learn accounting conceptually. Her tests are dang hard, but she gives you resources to succeed. I did not have to seek outside material. Accounting majors, take her!
its really not as bad as everyone says, just stay on top of studying and know the reasoning behind answers to problems. i got a C in 229 and an A in this class so really not that bad.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Cline is an excellent instructor who clearly explains both the concepts and how to apply them. However, her exams are challenging, so you need to invest significant time reviewing the material and completing practice exams to succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: take twedt

327 is a hard class, but Cline really provides great resources to succeed!! She cares a lot about her students, and the lectures are very in-depth. The exams are quite challenging, but an A is possible.

I struggled in 229 but Prof. Cline was genuinely so good at teaching the material. She explains things thoroughly and gives you all the resources to make an A! 327 gets a bad rep for being a difficult class but I promise if you put in the work you will be fine! Do NOT skip classes because notes do not make sense otherwise. Would recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor. I'm sure she will be one of my favorites throughout my time here. Incredibly structured and explains concepts thoroughly. Exams are extremely difficult, but anyone crying on here just didn't put in the time required for this weed out class.

TAKE PROFESSOR CLINE FOR 327!!!! I had a rough time in 229 and redeemed myself with an A in 327. It is so possible especially when you have an amazing and genuine professor like Cline. Her lectures are interesting to listen to and she explains everything in depth and like a middle schooler could understand it. She responds to emails so quickly too!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hard class no matter the prof. Exams are hard. Must know everything and not just memorizing. Cline was nice and explained throughly.

Dr. Cline really cares for her students! I think she gives some of the hardest exams out of the 327 profs, but she is a great lecturer and also provides old lecture videos in case you have to miss class. Do the practices and homeworks she gives, and redo all of her practice problems at least twice + practice exams to study and you will be fine.

She continuously gave out exams with mistakes and we had to work through time pressured exams with her mistakes. Everyone wants to talk with her out of class and I never got any help. She made me go through her stack of like 300 students exams to find my own. For an upper level class like 327, I expect more attention to be given to students.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Cline is an amazing professor for ACCT 327! She's always available outside of class and responds quickly to emails. Very approachable, she's willing to answer any questions, lecture-related or not. If you did well in ACCT 229, take her and put in the effort then you will do totally fine in ACCT 327. Highly recommend!

AMAZING professor, the material isn't hard to understand; however, her exams are difficult. She curves exams so that the class average is a 74. In my opinion, the first test was the hardest, 2nd and 3rd were the same, and the final was easier. Took w/ Finc 341 and getting an A is doable. I would take her instead of others. She is very understanding

Cline is an excellent professor for 327. Her midterms will likely be more difficult than other professors', but she more than makes up for this with her easier final exam and strong lectures. She responds to emails very quickly, even on nights and weekends, and has a large body of recorded lectures for students to use if they ever missed class.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Before Exam 3, she canceled class to go on vacation, thereby pushing back teaching approximately 50% of the exam material until less than a week before the exam. We had to rush through about 30% of the Exam 3 material just 4 days before the actual exam, and then she didn't even give us a curve to make up for her neglect. Usually no curve on exams.

Professor Cline is amazing and shows that she cares about her students through actions. The class is notoriously difficult, graded mostly by 4 exams. She is easily reachable through email. Once she curved the exam by 10 points because she made the it too hard and even apologized to us in person.

Amazing professor for a very difficult class. She is very reachable, caring, and flexible. She teaches hard concepts well and with clarity and has a lot of resources to help. I once emailed her with questions two days before an exam and she fully explained everything back in an email - clear that it took a lot of time and effort. Highly recommend!!

Genuinely one of the kindest professors I have had in college so far. Explains lecture material in way that makes complete sense and does a great job of making class engaging. This class is very tough but Cline provides a ton of resources to help you succeed. Highly recommend her class for 327.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Cline is by far the best professor I have ever had. This class is horrible but she makes it make sense with examples and shows she really cares for students success. She's easily available for help and is very generous with partial credit on exams. She is brilliant and makes the class manageable. 100% take her if you can.
Cline is a great Prof, 327 is a terrible class no matter who you take but she makes it tolerable

Professor Cline is the best professor for this class. She is very organized, articulate, and is always ready to help after class and in office hours. She really cares about her students and is willing to email back even on weekends! As a finance student, this class is tough, but she would be the professor you should take!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Cline is the GOAT. Best 327 prof out there. She responds to emails quickly and is very helpful in office hours and class. Take her study advice - you cannot pass if you don't do the practice problems she gives. Study a week or more in advance and you will be fine. Study last minute, not so much. She makes the class doable and less a weed-out.

Professor Cline was a very good lecturer and very kind. 327 is a very tough course, but it isn't anything different from 229 or 230 in terms of how you go about the class. This course had 3 exams and 1 cumulative final, online homework that was easy to get full credit on as long as you did the work, and one case study group project.

Professor Cline is the best professor I have had in my whole entire life. She's a good lecturer and she's just so so so kind. She's also very accessible outside of class and wants to see you succeed. There's 3 exams and a cumulative final and also homework. Take her!!!!!!
327 is a tough class and Professor Cline is always there to help.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: ACCT 327 is easily the hardest class Ive taken yet. Cline was always ready to answer my questions and further explain things. This class requires a lot of work and studying. Sometimes I would know everything on the exams and still make a low grade because I made dumb mistakes. Cline is a great professor just be ready to work your butt off
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: ACCT 327 is one of the hardest class at A&M so everyone struggles in this class, but Cline is a really good option for a professor. She explains things very clearly and ensures the entire class understands before moving on. She is always very accessible for questions and extra help outside of class. She really cares about her students.

Dr. Cline is amazing! She is very organized and, even though I had to take this class remotely, she made everything interesting and clear. She has a great notes packet and responds to emails super quickly. You can tell she just wants us to be successful and works hard for that. There's no need for the textbook, but there is online homework.

Dr. Cline was one of the best profs I've ever had. She's a really good teacher and very helpful outside of class. Intermediate accounting is definitely difficult, but Dr. Cline makes all of the concepts very clear and easy to understand. Her notes packet is also ideal for learning the material.

Amazing professor who truly cares about her students! ACCT 327 is tough in general but she gives clear criteria how to get the grade you want in her class. Whoever said she doesn't give practice exams is a liar bc she gives two old practice exams as well as practice problems and other tools for extra help. Use all of the tools & you will be fine.
no practice exams, have to guess what's going to be on the exam.

Dr. Cline provides all of the resources necessary to achieve an A in the class. She responds to email immediately and is always willing to work with people in her office hours. My favorite accounting professor so far! If you work consistently you will be fine.

She was super nice and willing to help if you asked for it. I had her her first semester teaching acct 327 and it was obvious. She was really good in the beginning  but towards the end of the semester she would speed really fast through things and also teach us wrong too. Tests got increasingly harder as the class went on. Overall, not bad for 327.

Literally the hardest thing I ever had to do. The test are supposed to be 2 hours long but nobody finishes in time so she gives us an extra 30 min and even then  you get an awful grade. I'm generally a B student  who tries to work hard but this class is really bad. She's nice, but her test are way to hard.
